test_buffer_protocol_matrix: test the pybind11 Matrix class buffer protocol by creating a 5x4 matrix and verifying memoryview shape and element access
test_buffer_info_ctypes: test get_buffer_info with ctypes arrays to verify itemsize, shape, strides, and readonly flags for 1D and 2D arrays
test_py_buffer_contiguity: test get_py_buffer with C contiguous, Fortran contiguous, and discontiguous matrices using PyBUF_SIMPLE, PyBUF_ND, PyBUF_STRIDES, and PyBUF_INDIRECT flags
test_readonly_buffer: test the BufferReadOnly class by creating a read-only buffer and verifying that memoryview raises TypeError on write attempts
test_format_descriptor_equiv: test format_descriptor_format_buffer_info_equiv to verify C++ type format strings match corresponding numpy dtype format descriptors
